-- question: Raft 怎么保证不丢已提交的日志
-- keywords: Raft 不丢已提交 不丢已 丢已提 已提交 日志

SELECT note_id, title, course, topic, source_type, tags,
       SUBSTRING(body, 1, 420) AS excerpt, fts_score, vec_score,
       ROUND(%s / (60 + COALESCE(fts_rank, 61)), 6) + ROUND(%s / (60 + COALESCE(vec_rank, 61)), 6) AS fused_score
FROM (
  SELECT note_id, title, course, topic, source_type, tags, body, fts_score, vec_score,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fts_score IS NULL ORDER BY fts_score DESC) AS fts_rank,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY vec_score IS NULL ORDER BY vec_score DESC) AS vec_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT note_id, title, course, topic, source_type, tags, body,
